why_relevant: Mass-market daily that amplified the BKS Bank IT-system failure story; useful as a corroborating second source and for customer-impact framing that dates migration go-live windows.

Telekom Slovenije-owned portal with a business vertical; syndicates Necenzurirano investigations and carries payments/finance consumer stories. Free access makes it a practical proxy for paywalled originals.

source_name: Telex.si - media aggregator view of Necenzurirano and other outlets
why_relevant: Slovenian news aggregator that indexes per-outlet feeds (confirmed page listing Necenzurirano items). Cheap way to discover which outlets are running a given bank/vendor story without subscribing to each.

source_name: Najdi.si Novice - Slovenian news search index
why_relevant: Domestic news search engine with per-outlet source pages (e.g. /vir/zurnal24). Best single pointer for enumerating which Slovenian outlets exist and for running Slovene keyword sweeps across all of them at once.
Largest-reach Slovenian news portal; reprints STA banking-fee and payments items and covers outages. Good for dating events and for capturing the public framing of a bank's supplier problems.

source_name: SRC InfoSRC - integrator's own journal (vendor-published trade content)
why_relevant: SRC is a major Slovenian systems integrator; its InfoSRC magazine publishes banking-digitalisation articles and names deployments (e.g. process-automation solutions in 13 regional banks). Vendor-authored, so treat claims as marketing, but it is a rich named-deal source.
Trade press for marketing/communications; covers bank brand relaunches, app launches and agency/vendor partnerships, which often front-run or corroborate a technology supplier change.
Consumer finance vertical that runs fintech-vs-incumbent market commentary in Slovene; useful for competitive-landscape framing and for spotting new payment providers entering the SI market.

Runs named-author commentary from Slovenian banking executives on fintech disruption (e.g. a piece by a bank CEO). Useful for actor-mapping decision makers and for their stated vendor/technology priorities.

source_name: NT konferenca (Brown Bear Team / conference coverage as press proxy)
why_relevant: Slovenia's largest ICT conference (1,400+ participants); sponsor lists, agendas and post-event trade coverage enumerate the active supplier set and who is pitching banking solutions this year - a compact actor map refreshed annually.

Most-visited Slovenian business site (approx. 240k monthly users per TSmedia); resolves supplier legal names, ownership and financials so press mentions of a vendor can be disambiguated and sized before further tracking.

Croatian ICT trade outlet covering the same Adriatic supplier set (Comtrade, SRC, Asseco SEE, Halcom) that serves Slovenian banks. Cross-border coverage often names deals that Slovenian outlets skip, and vice versa.

Trade outlet (ex-Banking Technology) that reports core-banking and payments vendor wins in small markets; confirmed to carry Slovenia-specific deal coverage (Oracle Flexcube at SID Banka, Bankart/Nets payments infrastructure). Keyword page acts as a standing country filter.

source_name: Finextra — news and vendor press-release channel
why_relevant: Carries both editorial deal coverage and vendor-submitted press releases (pressarticle path) — the exact channel by which foreign vendors announce Slovenian bank wins that never surface in Slovenian media. Confirmed Slovenian items: Bankart instant payments, NLB x Prepaid Financial Services.

Netherlands-based independent payments intelligence source; aggregates small-market payments infrastructure news (Slovenian instant payments / Flik, Bankart-Nets) and CEE vendor commentary. Strong for scheme, acquiring and PSP-vendor mapping.

The dedicated Southeast Europe business newswire; only outlet that systematically covers Slovenian bank M&A, ownership changes and IT-company deals in English (e.g. SKB-OTP sale, NLB/Addiko bid, TBS Group acquiring Slovenian IT integrator Actual I.T.). Ownership changes are the leading indicator of vendor re-tendering.
Cross-border view of banking sector moves across ex-Yugoslavia; catches a vendor or bank group winning region-wide (NLB, OTP, Addiko, Erste, UniCredit footprints) that a Slovenia-only view misses.

source_name: IBS Intelligence (IBSi) — news + Sales League Table / Core Banking vendor reports
why_relevant: Pure-play banking-technology research house tracking 400+ vendors and thousands of core-banking deals; the Sales League Table and Global Core Banking Vendors & Landscape Report are the closest thing to a systematic register of who won which bank, including small European markets. Also runs CEE company profiles.

source_name: The Fintech Times — country/ecosystem deep dives (Slovenia, Croatia)
why_relevant: Publishes recurring country ecosystem features that name local players, banks and regulators in one place — cheap actor-map refresher for Slovenia and the wider Adriatic; verified Slovenia and Croatia 2026 pieces exist.

CEE-wide English outlet covering tech, banking and investment across 23 countries including Slovenia; useful for cross-border context and government/EU-funded digitalisation angles. Did not surface Slovenia banking-vendor items in this run's searches, so relevance is assumed rather than demonstrated.

source_name: Tech.eu — CEE/Adriatic funding and deal coverage
why_relevant: European tech deal outlet with country deep-dives (verified Croatia 2025 piece); catches fintech funding rounds and acquisitions of Slovenian/Adriatic payment vendors before trade press does.

source_name: The Recursive — CEE/SEE startup and fintech mapping
why_relevant: Runs mapping articles listing 60+ CEE fintech companies by country — a pointer source that yields new actor names and their websites for the Slovenian/Adriatic vendor map.

source_name: STA English (Slovenian Press Agency, English service)
why_relevant: National wire whose English service is the bridge between Slovenian-language corporate announcements and international pickup; regional and trade outlets frequently source Slovenian bank/business items from it. Business desk covers bank operations, privatisation and corporate contracts.

Niche commercial-payments community outlet that republished the Bankart/Nets Slovenia instant-payments story — evidence it picks up small-market processor news; useful redundancy when Finextra/Paypers are paywalled.

Slovenia's national card/payment processor and the single most important counterparty for foreign payment vendors entering Slovenia; its own announcements are the primary artefact behind most trade-press items in this cell (Nets/Nexi partnership, Flik).

Commercial CEE sector report aggregating fintech company and deal data across the region including Slovenia; useful as a periodic structured cross-check on deal counts and named vendors rather than as a news feed.

source_name: Holland FinTech — State of FinTech in the Adria Region
why_relevant: Association-published regional overview treating Adria (Slovenia, Croatia, BiH, Serbia) as one unit — a pointer to regional actors, associations and events that the country-only view misses.
